title: the person screen shows the living line and, on an unknown person, its control
line: the foundation's living field, with its reason, reaches the person screen's own view; the screen's living control writes the owner's word through tools/conclude.py living with one audit row, exactly as app/person/server.py's route does; a person with held death evidence shows deceased with that reason and no word of the owner's to give

steps.say: a tier-two person with no death and no word: the screen's view carries unknown with its reason, the control's ground
a tier-two person with held death evidence: deceased with that reason, nothing for the owner to decide
the screen's control: the owner says the unknown person is alive, through the same function the route calls

expect.why: one audit row, as a fact row's decision writes one

steps.say: the screen's next view shows the flip
a word the route refuses: not one of the two the control offers, nor unknown to clear it
